title: Proteomics workflow for APP/Aβ TOMAHAQ analysis in endosomal and lysosomal fractions
author: Hankum Park
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bys8pwhw
materials: Perform TOMAHAQ experiments using the Tomahto software package on a Thermo Scientific Orbitrap Eclipse Tribrid mass spectrometer coupled to an Easy-nLC 1200 UHPLC system. Load each sample on a C18 column (30 cm, 2.6 μm Accucore [Thermo Fisher], 100 µm I.D.), and eluted using a 150-min method over a gradient from 5% to 38% B (95% ACN/0.125% formic acid). The instrument method only controlls Orbitrap MS 1 scans (resolution at 120,000; mass range 300−1500 m/z; automatic gain control (AGC) target 2*10 5 , maximum injection time 50 ms). Peptide targets are imported into Tomahto, and the following decisions are made by Tomahto in real-time.

For the absolute quantification of the target peptides, apply selected ion monitoring (SIM) experiments. Perform SIM experiments on a Thermo Scientific Orbitrap Eclipse Tribrid mass spectrometer coupled to an Easy-nLC 1200 UHPLC system. Load each sample on an in-house packed C18 column (30 cm, 2.6 um Accucore [Thermo Fisher], 100 µm I.D.), and elute using a 150-min method over a gradient from 5% to 38% B (95% acetonitrile, 0.125% formic acid). Monitor target peptides within a 50 min window around the scheduled retention time. Isolate a pair of trigger and target peptides, and accumulated separately targeting same AGC value (5*10 4 ; resolution at 240,000) and subsequently analyze in a single Orbitrap SIM scan. If two target peptides share similar retention time and same FAIMS CV values, multiplex their detections into a single SIM scan.

steps.title: Prepare samples
steps.instruction: Prepare all samples, including unfiltered PNS, Lyso, and Endo, as well as Amicon-filtered PNS_LMW, Lyso_LMW, and Endo_LMW, following the specified protocol (dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.byjfpujn).

steps.title: Reduce samples
steps.instruction: Reduce all samples by adding TCEP to a final concentration of 5 mM.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 25 ºC for 30 min with shaking.

steps.title: Alkylate cysteines
steps.instruction: Alkylate cysteines by adding iodoacetamide to a final concentration of 15 mM.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 25 ºC for 30 min with shaking.
Ensure samples are protected from light.

steps.title: Dilute samples
steps.instruction: Dilute samples with EPPS buffer to achieve a final urea concentration of 1.2 M.

steps.title: Precipitate proteins
steps.instruction: Add 6.1 N TCA solution to 20% final concentration.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 4 ºC for 1.5h.
Centrifuge samples at 21,000xg for 15 min at 4 ºC.
Remove supernatants.

steps.title: Wash and dry pellets
steps.instruction: Wash the protein pellets twice with ice-cold acetone.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 21,000xg for 10 min at 4 ºC for each wash.
Briefly dry protein pellets in a SpeedVac after the final wash.

steps.title: Resuspend and dilute pellets
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellets in 10 µL of 8 M urea buffer.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate in a water bath sonicator.
Dilute urea by adding 10 µL of 200 mM EPPS.

steps.title: Perform LysC digestion
steps.instruction: Add 0.3 µg of LysC and incubate at 37 ºC for 2h with shaking.

substeps.instruction: Further dilute urea to 1.6 M final by adding 200 mM EPPS.

steps.title: Perform Trypsin digestion
steps.instruction: Further digest peptides by adding 0.4 µg trypsin.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 37 ºC overnight with shaking.

steps.title: Label peptides with TMT
steps.instruction: Add acetonitrile (ACN) to 30% final concentration and label peptides by adding 3.6-5.3 µL of TMT 11-plex reagents (10 μg/μL in anhydrous ACN).

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 1h at 25 ºC with shaking.
Quench the labeling reaction by adding hydroxylamine to 0.5% final.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Dry and desalt samples
steps.instruction: Dry the pooled sample using a SpeedVac and desalt using a C18 StageTip.

steps.title: Add reference trigger peptides
steps.instruction: Add synthetic reference trigger peptides labeled with super-heavy TMTsh as described (dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.byjcpuiw).

steps.title: Process RAW files in Skyline
steps.instruction: Import RAW files from the SIM experiments into Skyline and extract precursor ion peaks with 10 ppm accuracy.

substeps.instruction: Measure the area under each peak for TMT-labeled target peptides and TMTsh-labeled trigger peptides (which share the same retention time).
Calculate the ratio between target and trigger.
Derive the absolute amount of target peptide by multiplying the ratio by the known amount of the trigger peptide.
Divide the absolute amount of target peptide by the relative quantitation from TOMAHAQ to calculate the absolute amount from each channel.

steps.title: Analyze data in R
steps.instruction: Export summed signal-to-noise ratio (S/N) to a csv file and analyze using R 3.6.3.

substeps.instruction: Adjust S/N of each channel using the vendor-provided isotopic impurity table of TMT reagents.
Normalize adjusted S/N values according to total reporter values in each channel based on a SPS-MS 3 analysis, assuming equal loading.
Test statistical significance between DMSO- and compound-treated groups using a two-sided Student’s t-test with the t_test() function in rstatix package version 0.7.0.
